inlines.v: COMPLEXED, a. 1. Composed of two or more parts or things; composite; not simple; including two or more particulars connected; as a complex being; a complex idea; a complex term.Ideas made up of several simple ones, I call complex; such as beauty, gratitude, a man, the universe.2. Involved; difficult; as a complex subject.
